title: About
goal: Our goal: to estimate the environmental footprint of generative AI during its use phase (inference), for the common use cases offered by the various service providers (Anthropic, Google, OpenAI, etc.), over a year of use.

existing.intro: Existing calculators offer a reading that is either:
existing.technical: technical (based on the number of tokens processed);
existing.perRequest: “per request”, which fails to reflect the volume effect of today's generative AI use, or the potential impact gap between types of use;

aims.intro: To raise awareness, this calculator therefore aims to:
aims.gaps: shed light on the impact gaps between types of use (or of request);
aims.annual: show the annual impact of a given use, for an individual or a group.

business.intro: For companies, it also aims to:
business.scale: make the impact tangible across all employees (or a group of employees), to raise awareness (as it stands, the tool is not designed to be used as an “accounting” dashboard);
business.code: put an additional focus on the use of generative AI as a coding assistant.
